description: Links human genes to cell types in which they show source-specific expression enrichment or differential expression. HPA, the Allen whole-human-brain atlas and the Allen HMBA basal ganglia atlas contribute distinct assessments and measurements.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was last created or changed.

source_contributions.scope: Single-cell RNA expression in normal human tissues, limited to cell type enriched, cell type enhanced and group enriched classifications. Low cell type specificity and not detected classifications are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Reports HPA gene specificity and breadth of detection for Cell Ontology cell types. A specificity score is supplied only for cell type enriched and group enriched genes. Ambiguous cell type names can resolve to a more general cell type, an accepted limitation of the source mapping.

properties.name: group
properties.description: HPA specificity classification: cell type enriched, cell type enhanced or group enriched.

properties.name: distribution
properties.description: Breadth of detection: detected in all, detected in many, detected in some or detected in single.

properties.name: specificity_score
properties.description: HPA single-cell-type specificity score, present only for the enriched classifications.

properties.name: specific_ncpm
properties.description: Original HPA cell type name and expression value, including its separator, retained verbatim.

properties.name: nCPM
properties.description: Numeric expression value from the HPA cell-type-specific nCPM field.

source_contributions.scope: Adult human brain expression from Siletti et al. 2023, restricted to the provisional cell types associated with that study and their qualifying Cell Ontology ancestors.
source_contributions.description: Cell Ontology relationships summarize enrichment in all underlying leaf clusters. Leaf calls require enrichment > 30, with no mean-expression cutoff. A parent qualifies only when every child qualifies; expression can be inherited downward through the cell type hierarchy, so absence of a direct edge does not imply absence of enrichment. Values pool the underlying leaf clusters against all other atlas clusters. Pooled enrichment may be ≤ 30 without invalidating the relationship.

properties.name: allen_group
properties.description: For these Cell Ontology relationships, "Allen enriched in all subtypes, pooled".

properties.name: allen_enrichment
properties.description: Pooled enrichment of the underlying clusters against all other atlas clusters, using both the fraction of cells with non-zero expression and mean expression.

properties.name: allen_mean_expression
properties.description: Cell-count-weighted mean expression across the underlying leaf clusters.

source_contributions.scope: Cell Ontology Group-level types in HMBA basal ganglia consensus taxonomy CCN20250428, using human cells only. Macaque and marmoset cells are excluded; Groups without human clusters have no expression relationships.
source_contributions.description: Identifies genes up-regulated in a Group relative to all other human basal ganglia clusters. Allen differential-expression criteria use a two-sided Welch t-test with Holm–Bonferroni correction (p < 0.01), penetrance > 0.5, relative penetrance difference > 0.7 and log2 fold change > 1. When fewer than 30 genes fully pass, approximate penetrance admits nearby candidates satisfying p < 0.01, penetrance > 0.1, relative penetrance difference > 0.1 and log2 fold change > 0.8. This evidence concerns the basal ganglia, rather than whole-brain specificity. Absence of an edge does not mean lack of expression. Relationships apply directly to Groups and are not inherited by their ontology parents.

properties.name: hmba_group
properties.description: "HMBA Group differentially expressed": the gene satisfies the Allen differential-expression criteria for this Group in human cells.

properties.name: hmba_log2_fold_change
properties.description: Group mean minus background mean in log2(CPM+1) units; > 0.8, and > 1 except for near-miss genes.

properties.name: hmba_mean_expression
properties.description: Mean expression across the Group’s human cells, in log2(CPM+1).

properties.name: hmba_mean_expression_other
properties.description: Mean expression across all other human basal ganglia clusters, in log2(CPM+1).

properties.name: hmba_fraction_expressing
properties.description: Fraction of the Group’s human cells with expression ≥ 1 CPM (log2(CPM+1) ≥ 1).

properties.name: hmba_fraction_expressing_other
properties.description: Fraction of cells expressing the gene at ≥ 1 CPM among all other human basal ganglia clusters.

properties.name: hmba_p_value
properties.description: Two-sided Welch t-test p-value, Holm–Bonferroni-corrected across genes. Probabilities are clipped and never zero; very small values around 1e-12 and below indicate at least that significance, rather than an exact probability.
